newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, demand thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, demand thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Thursday, with buyers staying sidelined amid a lack of fresh leads, traders said.

They said palm olein was mostly quoted at 1,415-20 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,410 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,170 rupiah/kg in the north Sumatran city of Medan on Wednesday.
"The market was sluggish, with buyers showing no significant interest," one trader said. "There were also no leads from Malaysia, where the export data was within expectations."

Cargo surveyor Caleb Brett put Malaysia's July bulk palm oil exports at 722,389 tonnes, against its estimate of 634,753 tonnes for June. Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) put July palm oil exports at 710,836 tonnes.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MV Ariva will for Singapore on Friday with 4,500 tonnes of palm olein, while the MT Marina 88 will leave for Batam with 1,600 tonnes of olein.
